start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] A Life in Haran
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You live in Haran with your father Terah, your wife Sarai, and your nephew Lot.
You are seventy-five years old.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Live as Abram in Haran, seventy-five years old
[TODO:pt-BR] Live as a young man in the city of Ur
[TODO:pt-BR] Live as king over a great nation

the_call.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Call of the Lord
the_call.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The Lord speaks to you.
What does He command?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] 'Go from your country, your people and your father's household to the land I will show you'
[TODO:pt-BR] 'Stay in Haran and worship the household idols'
[TODO:pt-BR] 'Build a temple to Me here in Haran'

the_promise.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Promise
the_promise.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The Lord adds His promise.
What does He say?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] 'I will make you into a great nation and bless you; all peoples on earth will be blessed through you'
[TODO:pt-BR] 'I will give you great riches to keep to yourself'
[TODO:pt-BR] 'You will have a long life and no descendants'

telling_sarah.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Your Household
telling_sarah.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You must prepare your family for the journey.
Who goes with you?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Take Sarai your wife and Lot your nephew
[TODO:pt-BR] Leave Sarai behind in Haran
[TODO:pt-BR] Go alone with only a walking staff

preparing.title: [TODO:pt-BR] What You Carry
preparing.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You gather what you will take on the journey.
What goes with you?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] All the possessions and people you have acquired in Haran
[TODO:pt-BR] Only a small bag of bread
[TODO:pt-BR] A chariot of gold from the king of Haran

departure.title: [TODO:pt-BR] You Set Out
departure.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The time has come to leave.
Where do you set out for?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Set out for the land of Canaan
[TODO:pt-BR] Set out for Egypt to become rich
[TODO:pt-BR] Set out with no destination in mind

the_road.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Into the Land
the_road.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You travel through the land of Canaan.
How far do you go?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Travel as far as the great tree of Moreh at Shechem
[TODO:pt-BR] Turn back to Haran halfway there
[TODO:pt-BR] Cross the sea to a distant island

doubt_night.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Lord Appears
doubt_night.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] At Shechem the Lord appears to you.
What does He say?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] 'To your offspring I will give this land'
[TODO:pt-BR] 'This land belongs to another people forever'
[TODO:pt-BR] 'Return to Haran; you were wrong to come'

stargazing.title: [TODO:pt-BR] At Shechem
stargazing.text: [TODO:pt-BR] You have heard the promise. What do you do at Shechem?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Build an altar there to the Lord who appeared to you
[TODO:pt-BR] Build a palace of cedar for yourself
[TODO:pt-BR] Say nothing and move on quickly

canaan_arrival.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Between Bethel and Ai
canaan_arrival.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You move on from Shechem into the hills.
Where do you stop and pitch your tent?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Pitch your tent in the hills between Bethel and Ai, and build another altar
[TODO:pt-BR] Pitch your tent in the city of Sodom
[TODO:pt-BR] Sail back across the river to Haran

altar.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Calling on the Name of the Lord
altar.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You call on the name of the Lord at your new altar.
The promise of a great nation goes with you as you journey on toward the Negev.
